pages.text: The canal looked black at night. Lots of stars seemed to float on the water.
"I want to count them all." Pongi looked up at the sky.
One, two, three... Pongi kept losing count.
Dad brought a telescope. "You can see them clearly with this."
Dad held the telescope to his eye. "Huh? Why are they so far away?"
Dad was holding the telescope the wrong way around. Pongi turned it around for him.
"Now I can see them clearly. Five!"
A little later, Dad said, "No, ten."
A little later still, he said, "There must be a hundred!"
Pongi looked into the water. There were lots of stars there too. "Dad, we have to count those too."
